description: This file contains a PHPUnit test suite for the SugarFeed class in the SuiteCRM project. It tests various functionalities such as creating SugarFeed records, activating/disabling module feeds, retrieving module feed files, and parsing messages.

classes.name: SugarFeedTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the SugarFeed class.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case environment, sets up global $current_user, and loads default config.

methods.name: testSugarFeed
methods.description: Tests creation and basic properties of the SugarFeed bean.

methods.name: testactivateAndDisableModuleFeed
methods.description: Tests activating and disabling module feeds via SugarFeed class methods.

methods.name: testgetModuleFeedFiles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of module feed files for valid and invalid modules.

methods.name: testgetActiveFeedModules
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of active feed modules.

methods.name: testgetAllFeedModules
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of all feed modules.

methods.name: testpushFeed2
methods.description: Tests pushing a feed related to a Lead bean and then deletes it.

methods.name: testpushFeed
methods.description: Tests pushing a feed message and retrieves it.

methods.name: fetchReplies
methods.description: Tests fetching replies for a feed.

methods.name: testgetLinkTypes
methods.description: Tests retrieval of link types for feeds.

methods.name: testgetLinkClass
methods.description: Tests getting link handler classes for different link types.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Tests retrieving list view data for a SugarFeed.

methods.name: testgetTimeLapse
methods.description: Tests computing the time lapse since a given date.

methods.name: testparseMessage
methods.description: Tests message parsing, especially hyperlinking URLs within text.
